name: desktop-picker-presentation
goal: Show actual historical, selected shared project and busy controls in Desktop catalog states

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Historical retains the tip hash; shared leaves the local project selected; busy opens a dialog that hides its disabled Add control.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing component-catalog-previews cases assert only generic picker controls. Extend their post-capture assertions for the actual older hash, selected shared project and visible disabled Add.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 0aa9178bd99e61738b7056e73d39009969a33545bdaa3451777cd457bb675861; nine existing picker cases fail across desktop, tablet and mobile on the visible historical/shared/busy markers.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Select the real shared-project snapshot, use the older committed fixture hash and leave busy closed so its disabled Add control is painted.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
